758:t_1:931.en:
$$刹那$$
「We can come to understand one another」

758:t_1:933.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Thank you, $$カティ$$... For letting him meet Princess $$マリナ$$.」

758:t_1:934.en:
$$カティ$$
「Don't mention it. It's the least I can do to see him off on his journey, now that he has achieved mutual understanding with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

758:t_1:935.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Look, $$グラハム$$. Even $$刹那$$ smiles like that, you know.」

758:t_1:936.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Indeed. It means he is no different from the rest of us.」

758:t_1:937.en:
$$カティ$$
「$$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$... So you will continue to fight on your own after all?」

758:t_1:938.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes... Because that is who we are, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

758:t_1:939.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「We keep fighting to protect the world... That is our mission.」

758:t_1:940.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Of course, depending on the situation, we'll cooperate with the $$連邦軍$$ too.」

758:t_1:941.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well... I can't picture you guys becoming part of the military anyway.」

758:t_1:942.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But someday, let us meet again. As comrades who wish for peace in the world.」

758:t_1:944.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You all take care, too.」

758:t_1:945.en:
$$マリー$$
「But we won't be seeing them for quite a while, though...」

758:t_1:947.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Did you say goodbye to the princess?」

758:t_1:948.en:
$$刹那$$
「There's no need. I fully intend to come back to Earth.」

758:t_1:950.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Understood, $$刹那$$. Allow me to accompany you on your journey.」

758:t_1:951.en:
$$ロックオン$$

758:t_1:952.en:
$$アレルヤ$$

758:t_1:953.en:
$$刹那$$

758:t_1:954.en:

758:t_1:956.en:
$$スメラギ$$

758:t_1:957.en:

758:t_1:962.en:
